schema:description: 注記: A manuscript. The title Chūzan Seifu zen is printed on both the outside and inside of the front cover. This manuscript is based on the version of Chūzan Seifu (Chūzan Genealogy) that was edited and revised by Sai Taku and Sai On, and was made by Minamotono Naoatsu. It records only a an abbreviated genealogy and history of the Kings of Ryukyu. Following the postscript, it seems that "Rinchi sensei ( another name for Yashiro Hirokata)" read and corrected some mistakes of Chūzan seifu (Sai On bon) and then Minamotono Naoatsu edited it. Completed in 1832. Minamotono Naoatsu was considered as one of disciples of Yashiro Hirokata who was a Japanese classical scholar in the late Edo period.(Updated on November 4, 2022)

写本。外表紙、内表紙とも『中山世譜 全』。本書は蔡鐸、蔡温らが編さん・改訂した『中山世譜』を元に、源直温が版をおこしたものである。王統の系図と歴代国王の略解のみを収録している。跋文によると、「輪池（りんち）先生」（屋代の別号）が『中山世譜』を読み、正誤を補ったものを、源直温が刊行したと記されている。天保3（1832）年成立。源直温（みなもとのなおあつ）は、江戸後期の国学者である屋代弘賢（やしろ・ひろかた）の門弟か。（2017年4月19日更新）

注記: This is a zigzag folded book with a wooden case. Colored drawings are included. It was edited by Matsui Nantai, also known as Matsui Shin, and published in 1854. Matsui was a painter of late 1850s who left behind many ukiyoe such as Gotōchi Onagori Ichikawa Ichizō, but his details are unknown. A paper strip with some notes, written probably by the author, has been attached in the middle of the book (just like a Post-it note). In addition, there is a book with the same title in other historical collections such as the Collection of Iwase and the Collection of Seikadō.

schema:description: 注記: 『十島図譜』は、白野夏雲(しらの・かうん)著、十島村役場編、単美社、昭和8(1933)年6月。鹿児島県令渡邊千秋の命により、白野は鹿児島県勧業課長として川辺郡十島村を調査し、『七島問答』・『十島図譜』を著して報告した。『十島図譜』の内容は、十島村の地誌である。白野が書いた自筆本は、鹿児島県令渡邊千秋の題辞を冠した状態で、鹿児島県庁の倉庫に長い間保管されていた。その後、自筆本は鹿児島県立図書館に移管された。本書は白野夏雲の自筆本をほぼ原図の通りに復刻したものである。十島についての研究は、白野以前には、田代安定や中田直慈くらいしかいないため、貴重である。復刻にあたって柳田国男が序文を寄せている。巻末には、永井龍一が、「白野夏雲翁と十島村」という題で文章を書き、夏雲翁の生涯と十島村との関係などを述べている。本書の蔵書印は3種類押されている。「鹿児島県立図書館蔵書之印」、「萬國屋」(蔵書印主不明)、フランク・ホーレーの「宝玲文庫」である。(2017年4月18日更新）

注記: Toshima Zufu was written by Shirano Ka'un, edited by Toshima village office, issued by Tambisha in June 1933. Under the order from Watanabe Chiaki, a County magistrate of Kagoshima prefecture, Shirano researched Toshima village of Kawabe county and reported the result of survey in writing Shichitō Mondō・Toshima Zufu. Toshima Zufu is a topography of Toshima. The handwriting book by Shirano himself was stored in a warehouse of Kagoshima prefecture, with an epigraph of Watanabe Chiaki, a county magistrate of Kagoshima prefecture. And then, that handwriting was transferred to the Kagoshima prefectural library. This book is a reprinted edition which was copied the original drawings quite well. It is valuable material because there were not many studies about Toshima before Shirano, except for Tashiro Antei or Nakata Naoji. Yanagida Kunio contributed a preface to this reprinted edition. In the end of the book, Nagai Ryūichi wrote "Shirano Ka'un Ō to Toshima mura" which was describing the life of Ka'un Ō and the relationship between the Toshima village and him. There are 3 ownership stamps in this book, which are; "Kagoshima kenritsu toshokan zōsho no in", "Bankokuya(the owner is unknown)" and "Hawley bunko" of Frank Hawley. (Updated on November 4, 2022)
